subject.title: fix(browser): prioritize exact tab target ids

question: Should this PR ship the fail-closed 409 behavior for raw-target/friendly-reference collisions, or should exact raw target ids continue to win over labels and tab aliases?
rationale: Both behaviors avoid wrong-tab actions, but the fail-closed path changes a documented compatibility surface for browser-control tab endpoints and needs maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Ship fail-closed collisions
options.body: Keep the current branch behavior, update any needed docs or PR wording, and require real browser/API proof that the 409 is the intended result.

options.title: Preserve exact raw priority
options.body: Change the resolver to prefer exact raw targetId matches before friendly aliases while still rejecting ambiguous prefixes and true cross-tab mismatches.

recommendation.title: Ship fail-closed collisions
recommendation.body: Keep the current branch behavior, update any needed docs or PR wording, and require real browser/API proof that the 409 is the intended result.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this PR and force-pushed the current head that implements the fail-closed collision rule.
